dependencies.name: OCRmyPDF
dependencies.note: Not bundled, expected on PATH. Installing it via Homebrew also installs Tesseract, Ghostscript, and qpdf as its own dependencies — nothing else to install separately. Version is what this app was last tested against — see internal/engine/engine.go's checkToolVersions for the runtime drift check.

requirements.name: Chrome or Chromium-based browser
requirements.note: Any Chromium-based browser works: Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Microsoft Edge, or Arc. Used to render the app's own UI window, same as the rest of this family of apps.
